title: Food groups and what they do

steps.say: Food gives your body energy and helps it grow and stay healthy. Different foods do different jobs.

figure.alt: Rice, an egg, a carrot and milk.

steps.say: Carbohydrates, like rice, bread and noodles, give you energy.
Proteins, like fish, eggs, tempeh and tofu, help your body grow and repair.
Fruit and vegetables give vitamins, minerals and fibre. These keep you healthy and help food move through your gut.
Fats, like oil and butter, store energy and keep you warm. We need only small amounts.
A balanced meal mixes foods from different groups. Drink water every day too.

check.prompt: Which food group gives you energy?

options.why: Proteins help you grow and repair.
Fibre helps food move through your gut.
Minerals, like calcium, help keep you healthy.

hints: This group is the body's main fuel.
It is a long word starting with c.
check.explanation: Carbohydrates, like rice and bread, give your body energy.

check.prompt: Fish, eggs and tempeh are rich in ___.
hints: They also help repair cuts and bruises.
check.explanation: Fish, eggs and tempeh are rich in protein, which helps the body grow and repair.
